summary: 28/30 checks pass. The documentation output is of high quality — 24 of 25 modules are correctly formatted with all required markers, substantive content, functional module naming, and proper dependency enrichment. The single critical gap is the azureblockblob/DETAIL.md, which was written in a non-standard format lacking YAML front matter and the required '<!-- module:xxx -->' opening marker. This causes R7, S2, and S5 failures. The root cause is agent execution error (the sub-agent for azureblockblob used a different output structure), not a Skill documentation defect — the DOC_TEMPLATES.md is unambiguous. No Skill defects were identified. The fix is straightforward: correct the azureblockblob DETAIL.md format, and optionally strengthen Phase 3 post-write validation in the Skill to verify YAML front matter before submit_analysis.
